166.title: Meat Bait Recipe
166.content: Pour <style="highlight">Winter's Kiss</style> over your cured meat. Add just enough to let that aroma soak in. Next, slice the <style="highlight">frosty meat</style> into thin strips—the texture is key! Once sliced, drizzle another layer of <style="highlight">Winter's Kiss</style> over the top and let it all meld together.

166.content: 漬け肉に<style="highlight">真冬の口づけ</style>を数回に分けてかけ、お酒の風味を肉に染みこませるようによく揉む。次に<style="highlight">氷霜の漬け肉</style>を細切りにし、最後に<style="highlight">真冬の口づけ</style>をまんべんなくかける。
